subject: Post-call findings + POC activation checklist — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call findings + POC activation checklist — Aurora Health

Hi Ellen / Tom — thanks for the call today. Quick post-call summary and a proposed activation checklist to get the POC moving.

Key pain points we heard
- High rate of clinical note mismatch across specialties; current ML pipeline has 12–15% label drift on discharge summaries.
- Latency spikes during batch ingestion causing throughput drop in peak windows.
- Strict PHI handling and regional residency requirements for patient data.

Goals we agreed
- Improve extraction accuracy on discharge summaries to >= 88% F1 for targeted entities.
- P95 inference latency < 200ms for 512-token requests during peak.
- Demonstrate secure ingest with audit logs and KMS-backed encryption.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks)
1) Week 0: access + data ingestion (de-identified corpus sample; up to 10k docs)
2) Week 1–2: model tuning and prompt/eval iterations (3 prompt sets, 5 eval slices)
3) Week 3: performance/runbook and cost tuning (batching, prefix cache)
4) Week 4: acceptance test and handoff (SLA targets, final eval report)

Success metrics (examples)
- Accuracy: >= 88% F1 on target entities
- Latency: p95 < 200ms (us-west2)
- Cost: < $X per 1k requests (will baseline after initial run)

Owners & immediate asks
- Aurora: provide S3 access (or secure share) for de-identified sample + point of contact for data mapping — Ellen
- Redwood: provisioning, prompt suite, and baseline eval — Marcus
- Security/compliance touchpoint: Karthik to lead KMS/SSO integration and log collection

Access/setup checklist (what we need to start)
- Temporary S3 bucket credentials (read-only) or transfer link
- Allowlist of IP ranges if Aurora requires network restrictions
- Completed DPO questionnaire (attached)
- Contact for console access and test accounts

Attachments
- aurora_poc_mtp_v1.xlsx (POC timeline + milestones)
- mvp_prompt_suite_v1.json (initial prompt set — attached to follow)
- Aurora_DPO_questions.pdf (security questions you referenced)

Next steps
- Ellen: confirm data share method and timeline by Wednesday 11/12
- Marcus: provision a sandbox cluster and send ephemeral creds by Friday 11/13
- Karthik/Grace: confirm KMS approach and any network constraints

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick follow-up to walk through the checklist.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Marcus — thanks for the thorough summary. This matches our notes.

Quick answers:
- We can prepare a de-identified S3 export. Can deliver a 5k doc sample by end of next week (11/17).
- Security: I'll send the completed DPO questionnaire (attached) and our baseline compliance notes.
- Network: we will likely need allowlisting; I will confirm our IP ranges.

One ask: can Redwood sign a DSP addendum for the sample dataset (minimal terms)? Our legal team will want to see it before transfer.

I'll loop in our infra lead if we need more technical coordination.

Appreciate the clear owners — Ellen

Ellen Park
